$comment: Companions (pet cosmetics in career/cosmetics.json): painted stills that sit by a player's side of the battlefield in PetSpot, and in the locker.
style: Companions: one small, cute creature or object per cell, whole body, sitting or standing on an implied ground line, three-quarter front view, as an ivory pictogram, ivory ink ONLY, friendly and round, filling about 85% of its cell.

items.subject: a small fox kit sitting, its tail curling up like a flame
a little otter floating on its back holding a shell
a tiny tortoise with ferns and a mushroom growing on its shell
a folded origami crane standing on one foot
a round clockwork owl with gear eyes and a key in its back
a fluffy moth with wings patterned like a lantern
a chubby baby dragon sitting with stubby wings raised
a small hare with a leaf tucked behind one ear, sitting upright
a sitting cat with a crescent moon on its forehead and stars on its fur
a small treasure chest with a toothy grin and a tongue poking out, on little legs
